title: New Year's Eve at Terry's
summary: Brendan “Pianomaniac” and Rohan Windle lead a duelling piano marathon at Terry's in Rye from 7:30pm, with karaoke and a midnight countdown. The ticket page lists dinner and selected drinks as part of this 18+ event; check inclusions and availability before booking.
